reviews.name: EMMA.P
reviews.body: These pads are very refreshing and keave my skin a nice blank canvas fir the rest of my skin care, i would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Hetty
reviews.body: Cleared my hormonal acne! I have a very simple skin routine and use the Tacha face wash with the dewy skin cream. I needed something to help give my skin a clear base before putting on the cream as I noticed it worked negatively with my hormonal acne. I use these pads once a day in the morning and my skin has never been so smooth, glowy, most importantly no more hormonal acne!!!

reviews.name: Debs978
reviews.body: My daughter is 18 and very prone to large pores and spots. She has very oily skin. Since using these black heads aren’t as visible for her. Spots are less prominent. I would recommend to anyone with similar skin type.

reviews.name: Hannah
reviews.body: Helped with small bumps! These have helped my skin tremendously, been trying to find a way for gentle exfoliation for a while and these are so soothing and I had no purging which for me is incredible considering my skin is so sensitive.

reviews.name: TGZ
reviews.body: Long lasting, hydrating and good to use each season. I can see progress with clean pores and overall skin health

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.body: These are really good, you get soo much in the tub also. Definitely seeing a small improvement

reviews.name: Katie
reviews.body: Only used once but made my skin feel really soft. Excited to see more results
